text: Patrick Galbraith and Todd Witsken were the defending champions, but played with different partners this year. Witsken partnered with Ken Flach and was eliminated in the second round by Bryan Shelton and Kenny Thorne. Galbraith partnered with Danie Visser and won the title, defeating Andre Agassi and John McEnroe 6–4, 6–4 in the final. The first four seeds received a bye into the second round.
